errors.text_span: The blue line starts at approximately 0.95
errors.evidence: The blue line clearly starts at y=1.0 (10^0) on the y-axis, not 0.95.

errors.text_span: peaking at around 0.1 at 3200 training steps
errors.evidence: The peak of the orange line at 3200 training steps is visibly below the 10^-1 (0.1) line, at approximately 0.08 or 0.09. Stating it peaks at 0.1 is an overestimation.

errors.text_span: decreasing to approximately 0.03 at 6400 training steps
errors.evidence: The final value of the orange line at x=6400 is closer to 0.02 than 0.03. On the logarithmic scale, 0.03 would be noticeably higher.
